title: No famous stars this time
description: Eight packets of real archive data with identity, coordinates and dates scrubbed, all from Oddsky's own casebook: obscure stars, several catalogued but none with a paper describing what it does. Four blind (name the explanation), with answers that are Oddsky's own conclusions rather than literature, including one ordinary star. Four hindsight (data cut at a date; forecast what happens next, graded against what the sky did). Three of the hindsight stars are open questions: nobody knows what they are, so their class is not scored, only their forecasts.

classes.dust_occultation: Circumstellar dust passes in front of the star (debris, disk warp, clump).
classes.dust_formation: The star makes its own dust (R CrB-like declines, AGB/post-AGB episodes).
classes.collision_debris: Debris from a collision: IR excess first, optical extinction later.
classes.eclipse_companion: A companion or its disk eclipses the star (long-period, often dusty).
classes.yso_dipper: Young star with variable extinction from an inner disk.
classes.microlensing: A foreground star or remnant passes almost exactly in front: achromatic, smooth, never repeats.
classes.artifact_instrumental: The spacecraft, detector or pipeline did it.
classes.artifact_blend: A neighbour did it: the signal is real but belongs to another star.
classes.normal: Nothing to explain at the precision of the data.
